description: This file declares functions and structures related to the fsmonitor index extension in a version control system, including reading, writing, adding, removing, and refreshing the fsmonitor extension, as well as checking response triviality.

methods.name: read_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Reads the fsmonitor index extension and restores the CE_FSMONITOR_VALID state if configured.

methods.name: fill_fsmonitor_bitmap
methods.description: Fills the fsmonitor_dirty ewah bits with their state from the index before it is split during writing.

methods.name: write_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Writes the CE_FSMONITOR_VALID state into the fsmonitor index extension from the index.

methods.name: tweak_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adds or removes the fsmonitor extension based on the core.fsmonitor setting.

methods.name: refresh_fsmonitor
methods.description: Runs the configured fsmonitor script and invalidates related cache structures, optimizing to run only once.

methods.name: fsmonitor_is_trivial_response
methods.description: Checks if the received response from fsmonitor contains the 'trivial' response.
